name: Jeremiah
overview: The book of Jeremiah reveals God's sovereign calling and intimate knowledge of His prophet even before birth, as God ordained Jeremiah to be a prophet to the nations. Jeremiah faithfully delivers God's message amid opposition, assured by the Lord's promise of His presence and protection. The prophet confronts Israel's spiritual unfaithfulness, lamenting how the people have forsaken God, the 'fountain of living waters,' in pursuit of worthless substitutes, illustrating the nation's deep apostasy during the days of King Josiah.
